Master Chef Graccu is the namesake and supposed creator of :Graccu's Homemade Meat Pie and :Graccu's Mince Meat Fruitcake, two of the food articles sold by Smokywood Pastures during the Feast of Winter Veil. The latter is marketed as being "preserved with Graccu's special spices". When the Abominable Greench steals one of Smokywood's treat shipments each year, company representatives claim that "Graccu himself will miss out on sharing his delicious meat pies with all the good boys and girls this season" unless the treats are returned. It's unclear if Graccu is a real person or only an advertising mascot.

The Great Kyron is the leader of the Lamplighters of the Hallowfall Arathi. They served as a warden in the Arathi Army for many years before accompanying the expedition to Hallowfall, where they found their calling late in life by creating the Lamplighters. During the Kaheti attack on the Aegis Wall, Kyron was left behind when General Steelstrike ordered the Army to pull back. Faerin Lothar, accompanied by Anduin Wrynn and an adventurer, reunite with Kyron, and together the group fights off the Kaheti and reignites the keyflame atop the wall.
